worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.summary: After a confirmed sacrifice, release one mist burst against reachable enemies. Damaged targets lose two Accuracy stages briefly. Actual Misty Terrain strengthens the burst; the fading mist is visual.
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.descrip: The ring blooms outward along the ground, dealing about %1$s special damage once to every non-ally around the user, up to %2$s targets.
The ring radius is %1$s blocks; it is also the move's real range and indicator circle.
While grounded in live Misty Terrain on the same surface, multiply this burst by %1$s.
Targets actually damaged lose 2 Accuracy stages for %1$s. Expiry or dispelling removes this contribution.
The explosion leaves a brief wisp of mist that fades without slowing targets or dealing further damage.
Wind-up %1$s, cooldown %2$s. Preparation can be interrupted. The mist is released only after a complete sacrifice; rescue or refused payment grants no burst.
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.dense.o: Dense mist: wider, longer fading mist and +30 ticks of impaired aim; power ×0.92, wind-up +3, cooldown +10.
Thin burst: power ×1.08, a smaller lingering mist, cooldown −6 — crisper and faster.
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.use.0: Trade a sacrifice for a burst and brief impaired enemy aim
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.use.1: Detonate harder while standing in mist
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.use.2: Clear the space around an ally with the mist ring
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.prefere: Dense mist extends impaired aim and the fading visual, with a lighter burst and longer wind-up/cooldown. Thin burst hits harder with a smaller visual. Both require a complete sacrifice.
Beyond this distance the companion first closes in rather than detonating; this is a move for a tight ring.
How many visible, living targets must be inside the ring before detonating. Higher saves it for being surrounded; at 1 it fires on a single target.
Below this health fraction the detonation count drops to 1. Higher makes the companion go all-in sooner.
From level %1$s the blast gains another step (power about %2$s, radius about %3$s).
world_combat.move.mistyexplosion.text.mi: The mist only covered the ground
